request: Write a Flask endpoint that deletes a user account.
contract: Write `create_app()` returning a Flask app with `DELETE /api/users/<int:user_id>` that removes the user and returns status 204, or status 404 if the user does not exist.
The app starts with users with ids 1, 2 and 3 in memory.

Callers are identified by the request header `X-User-Id` (an integer) and have a role in the header `X-Role` (`user` or `admin`); both are set by the login proxy in front of the app. A request without `X-User-Id` gets status 401.
